regression_inputs.regressionPurpose: Positive exact-current-input student format binding; original nine subject fixtures retained unchanged.

regression_contracts: Toby advice has no binding requested-format provenance.
Canonical resolution missing/ambiguous blocks Question authoring and publication; no invented ID or silent MCQ downgrade.
P03: unreported uncertainty cannot imply no laboratory error.
M01: one block beyond selected maximum fails; one bounded repair reselects/consolidates purposefully, never adds filler or silently raises a protected limit.
Standard depth is real reference-render core geometry plus substantive instructional review; PDFs/video/padding do not count.
Late/unavailable/unreviewed PDF drops before freeze without changing core or leaving tokens/headings/links.
Smart Homework retains independently authored learner work; exploration/chemistry saves/branch clicks are not assessed proficiency.
